writeup: TIC 468017028 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.4081 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing a 2.01% dimming of the star's light, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 70.8 in the periodogram. No secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal originates near the target location, with a centroid offset of 1.6 arcsec and a peak signal-to-noise of 12.4 in difference imaging. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel find. The pipeline's machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.32 on a scale where higher values indicate greater confidence in the target's reality, and the candidate passed all data quality checks without flagged issues.
